title: Male DNA in Women
author: elio walker
description:
Hello everyone, and welcome to today's episode.

Have you ever heard someone say that a woman carries a man's DNA forever after they have sex? It's a claim that's been circulating on social media for years, but is it actually true?

Today, we're exploring the science behind this fascinating topic and separating facts from fiction.

Let's begin with the basics.

DNA is the genetic material found in nearly every cell of the human body. During sexual intercourse, millions of sperm cells enter the female reproductive tract. These sperm cells contain the man's DNA. However, if pregnancy does not occur, the female body naturally clears out these sperm cells over the following days.

Research shows that sperm cells can survive inside the female reproductive tract for up to five days under favorable conditions. During this period, small traces of male DNA may still be detectable using advanced forensic techniques. After that, the body's natural processes remove these cells, and there is no scientific evidence that DNA from a sexual partner permanently becomes part of a woman's own genetic makeup.

So where did the myth come from?

The confusion often comes from a real biological phenomenon called microchimerism.Microchimerism

occurs primarily during pregnancy. As a baby develops, a small number of fetal cells can cross the placenta and enter the mother's bloodstream. Likewise, some maternal cells can enter the fetus. These fetal cells may remain in the mother's body for years—or even decades—after pregnancy.

If the baby is male, some of these long-lasting fetal cells contain a Y chromosome inherited from the father. Scientists have detected male fetal cells in the blood, organs, and even the brains of some women many years after giving birth to a son.

This discovery is fascinating, but it's important to understand what it means.

These are not cells from the woman's sexual partner that permanently changed her DNA. They are fetal cells that originated from the baby during pregnancy. The mother's own DNA remains unchanged.

Another common myth claims that every woman permanently stores DNA from every man she has ever been with. Modern scientific research does not support this claim.

Experts agree that while traces of sperm DNA can be detected for a short period after intercourse, they do not become a permanent part of a woman's body through normal sexual activity. The long-term presence of male DNA is associated with pregnancy and fetal microchimerism—not with sexual intercourse alone.

Researchers are still studying whether fetal microchimerism has health effects. Some studies suggest these fetal cells may help with tissue repair or play a role in the immune system, while others are investigating possible links with autoimmune diseases. The science is still evolving, and many questions remain unanswered.

If someone wants to determine whether male DNA is present after a recent sexual encounter or pregnancy, specialized forensic DNA testing laboratories may be able to detect extremely small amounts of DNA using advanced laboratory methods. However, these tests are designed for specific medical or forensic purposes and should be interpreted by qualified professionals.

So, what are the key takeaways?

First, sperm DNA may remain detectable for several days after intercourse, but it is naturally cleared from the body.

Second, pregnancy is different. Through fetal microchimerism, fetal cells containing both maternal and paternal DNA can remain in the mother's body for many years.

And finally, there is no scientific evidence that a woman permanently absorbs or stores the DNA of every sexual partner simply through intercourse.

If you'd like to explore this topic in greater detail, including the latest scientific explanations and frequently asked questions, visit our complete guide, How Long Does a Man's DNA Stay Inside a Woman?, on the ChoiceDNA website.

Science often reveals answers that are more interesting—and more nuanced—than popular myths.

Thank you for listening to today's episode. If you enjoyed this discussion and want to learn more about DNA testing, genetics, and the science behind human biology, be sure to explore more educational resources from Choice DNA.

Until next time, stay curious, keep asking questions, and always let science guide the conversation.

The Art of War Podcast: Lessons of Sun Tzu on Strategy, Leadership, and Success explores the timeless principles of Sun Tzu and shows how they apply far beyond the battlefield. From ancient empires, biblical and Church history, Rome, the Crusades and the Reformation to revolutions, wars and modern history, the series asks what really happened, why it matters and how the past still shapes the present.

title: Thrive after a heart attack
author: Luiza Holtzberg, MA, NBC-HWC | Heart Health Coach
description:
You’ve survived a heart attack, you’re living with significant cardiovascular risk, or you are caring for a loved one who has survived a heart attack. What comes next can feel overwhelming. Confusing advice, fear of another cardiac event, and uncertainty about how to safely make lifestyle changes often leave people stuck in anxiety rather than action. The “Thrive after a heart attack” podcast is designed to change that.


Hosted by Luiza Holtzberg, heart health coach and founder of Wingspan Wellness. Luiza is a National Board Certified Health and Wellness Coach, certified medical exercise specialist, and experienced cardiac rehabilitation exercise specialist with over a decade in the field.  This show provides guidance for life after a heart attack. Luiza helps listeners move out of fear and into clarity, rebuilding trust in their bodies while making sustainable changes that truly support heart health.


Each episode of "Thrive after a  heart attack” focuses on the core pillars of recovery and prevention: heart-healthy nutrition, restorative sleep, safe and effective physical fitness, and emotional and mental resilience. Instead of overwhelming medical jargon or conflicting advice, listeners receive practical strategies that fit into real, busy lives.


New episodes are released every Wednesday. Be sure to hit that follow button so you never miss guidance that helps you feel safer in your body and more confident in your daily choices.


To learn more or connect directly, visit www.wingspanwellbeing.com or email luiza@wingspanwellbeing.com.

title: Pick It Up: The AI Culture Podcast
author: Pratish Kotecha
description:
Most AI initiatives don’t fail because the technology is moving too fast - they fail because the culture isn’t ready to move with it.

Welcome to pickIT Up: The AI Culture Podcast, hosted by Pratish, AI Transformation & Change Lead.

Every fortnight, we cut through the technical noise and corporate hype to focus on the real engine of digital adoption: the human side of AI. 


In each 20-minute episode, we break down practical ways to build an AI-native organisation using our 4 Cs framework:

  • Capability: Building confident, AI-literate leadership.
  • Competency: Mapping real adoption pathways (Apply > Optimise > Transform).
  • Connectivity:  Orchestrating grassroots innovation across business silos.
  • Culture: Fostering curiosity, psychological safety, and continuous learning.


We spend 15 minutes diving deep into the core strategy, then wrap up every show with our signature 5-minute PickIT & Mix - delivering a rapid-fire grab bag of actionable prompt hacks, micro-playbooks, and team exercises you can take away and use right now.

Whether you're leading enterprise change, steering an AI strategy, or driving adoption across your teams, tune in every two weeks for a sharp, 20-minute masterclass to help you pick up the future of work.

title: Love, Deen & Real Life
author: Zayd & Fatimah
description:
Look, we’ve all been there. You finally find someone you want to spend the rest of your life with. Your khitbah is hard, filled with tests, obstacles, and pressure from every direction. You cannot help but imagine how much easier life will become once you finally marry the person you love.

So you get married—and then a whole new set of problems appears.

Your relationship is no longer being threatened by your parents, their parents, or the obstacles keeping you apart. Now, the problem is that neither of you really knows what you’re doing. No one taught you how to build a healthy marriage, meet each other’s needs, or handle the weight of real life together. Suddenly, these new struggles can feel even heavier than the ones you faced before marriage.

Trust us—we’ve been there.

We made du’a day and night, asking Allah to help us protect our love, strengthen our lives, and keep our deen at the center of our marriage. Then one day, things began to click—not because all our problems disappeared, but because we decided to take responsibility for building the marriage we wanted.

We discovered shortcuts and learned when it was actually okay to use them. We learned how to meet each other’s needs, filter out bad advice, communicate through difficult moments, and face hardship as a team instead of turning against each other.

We are not here to lecture you about what it means to be the perfect husband or wife. We are not scholars or marriage therapists. We are simply a Muslim couple sharing our story, the lessons we learned, the mistakes we made, and the things that genuinely helped our marriage grow.

You are not alone—and our stories will prove it.

Join Zayd and Faatimah each week as we tackle the real issues Muslim couples face in love, deen, and everyday life. We hope our experiences can help you—and maybe one day, insha’Allah, we will get to hear your story too.

Gospel Unfiltered is a one-hour weekly podcast that goes beyond the pulpit to create space for honest conversations, real stories, and Kingdom truth. Beyond the Pulpit: Honest Conversations. Real Stories. Kingdom Truth.

title: The Debrief with Eric Immesberger
author: Eric Immesberger
description:
What really happens behind the scenes of the investigations you hear about in the news?

Hosted by retired ATF Special Agent Eric Immesberger, The Debrief goes beyond headlines to explore the decisions, psychology, preparation, and lessons behind some of the most dangerous investigations in America.

With more than 35 years in law enforcement, Eric spent his career infiltrating violent criminal organizations, posing as a hitman, investigating firearms trafficking, explosives, bank robberies, home invasion crews, and murder-for-hire plots. He also responded to Ground Zero after 9/11 and spent months assisting in the recovery effort.

Each episode breaks down real cases, interviews the investigators who lived them, and examines the mindset, tactics, and human behavior that determine success when the stakes are highest. Along the way, Eric shares practical insights anyone can use to improve awareness, decision-making, and personal safety.

Whether you’re fascinated by true crime, interested in law enforcement, or simply want to become harder to fool and better prepared, The Debrief gives you the lessons most people never hear.

Be Smart. Be Safe.

title: SAP Security Expert Conversations

description:
SAP Security Expert Conversations is a podcast dedicated to the world of SAP Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Identity & Access Management (IAM), cybersecurity, AI, fraud management, risk management, and enterprise technology.

description: RESET – Why Didn't Anybody Tell Me This? is a podcast that challenges conventional thinking about health, aging, and chronic disease. Hosted by Dr. Catie Harris, each episode explores the biology behind why our bodies adapt, why symptoms develop, and how understanding cellular function can transform the way we approach health. Instead of asking, "What disease do you have?" we ask a different question: "Why did your biology adapt this way?" If you've ever wondered why nobody explained how the body really works, this podcast is for you.

description: Unlikely Partners spotlights the Israelis and Palestinians who dare to build bridges where others see only walls. Through intimate conversations with people from both sides, the show reveals stories of cooperation, innovation, and hope that rarely make headlines but can help make for a better future. title: The Applied Aesthetics Podcast
author: Dr. Alison Colville
description:
The Applied Aesthetics Podcast is where clinical excellence, critical thinking and real world experience come together to explore the realities of modern aesthetic medicine.


Hosted by award winning aesthetic physician, international educator and mentor Dr Alison Colville, this podcast brings a global perspective to the conversations shaping our specialty. Drawing on more than 20 years of medical experience, a decade as a GP and her work as a clinician, researcher, lecturer, KOL and Clinical Advisor to the JCCP, Alison explores the challenges, opportunities and responsibilities that come with practising aesthetic medicine today.


Through solo episodes and conversations with some of the most respected voices in global aesthetics, The Applied Aesthetics Podcast goes beyond techniques and trends to explore the deeper questions facing practitioners:


  • How do we make better clinical decisions?
  • How do we manage complications, uncertainty and risk?
  • How do we build confidence without ego?
  • How do we navigate relationships with brands, industry partners and colleagues whilst maintaining integrity?
  • And how do we build careers that are both successful and sustainable?


From anatomy, complications and regenerative medicine to psychology, business, leadership and the future of our specialty, this is a podcast for practitioners who want to think more deeply, practise more ethically and contribute to a stronger, more evidence based future for aesthetic medicine.


Because great aesthetics isn’t simply about knowing how to perform a treatment. It’s about developing the judgement, confidence and professionalism to know when, why and whether to perform it at all.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Hosted by Natachia Walton, each episode explores the connection between physical health, mental resilience, faith, personal growth, and purpose. You’ll hear honest conversations about wellness, entrepreneurship, overcoming challenges, building sustainable habits, and creating a life aligned with your values.
Whether you’re looking to improve your health, grow personally, or stay encouraged on your journey, this podcast is here to remind you that true wellness goes far beyond the gym.
Ready to take the next step in your wellness journey? Visit Constructive Wellness at https://constructivewellness.org to learn more about coaching, resources, and support for your growth.

title: A WoW Podcast, Obviously

title: Becoming: Monday after Sunday
author: Johnny Simmons
description: Becoming: Monday After Sunday is a faith-centered podcast hosted by Youth Pastor Johnny Simmons, exploring life beyond the pulpit. While Sunday is filled with worship, preaching, and purpose, Monday brings real-life challenges, responsibilities, and opportunities for growth. Through honest conversations, biblical insight, and personal experiences, Johnny shares what it means to live out your faith daily and continue becoming the person God has called you to be when the service ends, and real life begins.

title: The Goal is Soul
author: Benjamin Epstein
description:
The Goal Is Soul is a place to stop, catch your breath, and remember what really matters. I'm Dr. Benjy Epstein, a clinical psychologist in Jerusalem, and this is your guide to living with more courage, presence, and soul.
Each week we'll share two episodes, usually ten to fifteen minutes each. Soul Talk is a short teaching that begins with something familiar from psychology and opens into the older contemplative and spiritual traditions. Soul Practice is a guided mindfulness meditation built to move the teaching from your head into your body, and finally into your soul.
Anxiety. Burnout. Grief. Addiction. Loneliness. The feeling that you're never quite here.
You don't have to fix any of it. You are not a role. You are a soul. Consider this your weekly reminder to be here now. Together.
New episodes every Sunday at 7 PM ET, to start your week with intention and soul.
Contact: Benjy@thegoalissoul.com

title: Life Upc's Past Services

description: Welcome to the official podcast of Life Church Mount Pleasant in Mount Pleasant, Texas. Join us as we share powerful Apostolic preaching, encouraging biblical teaching, and weekly messages from Pastor James Prentice Burks and special guests. Whether you missed a Sunday worship service, want to revisit a Wednesday night Bible class, or just need a mid-week spiritual boost, our podcast archive brings the sanctuary directly to you. Subscribe to stay connected and grow in your faith with the Life Church family!

title: AI Rising
author: Nicolas Samwer
description:
Conversations with the minds driving artificial intelligence.

AI Rising is a podcast about the people, ideas, and questions behind the most important technology of our life time. Host Nicolas Samwer, a high school student deeply curious about where AI is taking us, sits down with professors, researchers, and practitioners to explore what artificial intelligence really is, what it can do, and how it will define our future. 

Each episode is a 20-30 minute conversation built around technical expertise and insight rather than hype. Whether you're new to AI or already working in the field, AI Rising is the place to learn what is happening from the coal face.

title: Investor Circle
author: Stewart Noakes
description:
Investor Circle is the  podcast series from Canopy Community brought to life to capture insights from investors across the globe. In each short interview we get under the skin of how the investors think and make decisions as well as what kind of people they are. 

Our goal is to build empathy within the community of the what, when, who, how and why behind raising funding for your startup. #Empatia

This series is primarily for Founders of early stage startups who are looking to raise their first funding, but it’s also helpful for investors looking to raise their first funds and for anyone in the ecosystem who is interested in how this all works.

https://www.canopy.community/

Note: you can also watch these episodes on youtube.com/@canopycommunity617

title: Lights, Lines, and Leadership: The Podcast for Dance & Drill Team
author: Kelli Woodruff
description:
Lights, Lines, & Leadership is the podcast for dance and drill team directors, dancers, parents, and other industry professionals. 


From Friday night lights to contest season, we're talking about leadership, performance, team culture, traditions, and everything happening behind the scenes. Real conversations. Real experiences. Stronger teams.

title: Single Minded
author: Sheri Merritt Boulet
description: Single Minded is a Christ-centered podcast hosted by Sheri Boulet for anyone seeking to live wholeheartedly for Jesus. Through biblical teaching, personal testimony, and practical encouragement, each episode explores what it means to embrace every season with faith, purpose, and peace. Whether you’re single, divorced, widowed, or simply longing for a deeper walk with God, you’ll be encouraged to keep your heart fixed on Christ above all else.

title: Unlocked Doors
author: Unlockeddoorspod
description: Unlocked Doors is a podcast that shines a light on the realities of domestic violence, sexual assault, coercive control, and the journey from surviving to healing. Hosted by a nurse, educator, and survivor, each episode blends personal insight, expert conversations, survivor stories, and practical resources to break the silence, challenge misconceptions, and inspire hope. Whether you're a survivor, someone who loves one, or simply want to better understand the hidden realities of abuse, you're welcome here. Because healing begins when we unlock the doors that silence has kept closed.

title: Prodcast - Powerful Radio Production
author: Dom Evans
description: Whether you're actively listening, or it's just on in the background, radio production has the unique ability to move an audience. It can make people laugh, cry, or even experience goosebumps. This podcast goes behind the scenes with the audio producers tasked with crafting the sound of radio stations worldwide.

title: Dinomania Prehistoric Pod
author: Ranger Chris
description: Welcome to Dinomania Prehistoric Pod, the ultimate podcast for dinosaur enthusiasts! Join us as we journey back in time to explore the incredible world of prehistoric creatures. In each episode, we bring you thrilling stories, fascinating facts, and expert insights into the lives of these ancient giants. From the mighty Tyrannosaurus Rex to the graceful Brachiosaurus, we cover a wide range of dinosaur species, uncovering their behaviors, habitats, and the latest scientific discoveries. Whether you're a seasoned paleontologist or just a curious listener, Dinomania Prehistoric Pod offers a perfect blend of education and entertainment. So, get ready to ignite your imagination and embark on an exciting adventure into the lost world of dinosaurs. Tune in to Dinomania Prehistoric Pod, where the past comes roaring back to life!

title: Monday Mindset Reset
author: Latosha Leonard
description: Monday Mindset Reset is a weekly podcast hosted by licensed counselor and transition specialist Latosha D. Leonard, LPC. Each episode is 10–15 minutes built around one idea from the Middle of Change framework — the philosophy that the space between what ended and what hasn't started yet is a real, navigable place.  Every week includes a short teaching, a guided practice you do in the episode, and one honest reflection question to carry into the week. For women navigating life transitions, identity shifts, and the quiet disorientation that doesn't have a name yet.

title: The Gutsy Brain MD
author: Dr. Rana Mafee
description: The Gutsy Brain MD explores the powerful connection between your gut and your brain—and how nurturing both can transform your health. Hosted by double board-certified neurologist and integrative medicine physician Dr. Rana Mafee, each episode translates the latest research on the gut-brain axis, microbiome, nutrition, lifestyle, and functional medicine into practical strategies to improve mood, memory, focus, digestion, and long-term health. Together, we'll challenge outdated medical silos and discover what's possible when we stop treating the gut and brain as separate systems.

title: Menopause Unscripted Podcast
author: Farah Kariamburi
description:
Welcome to the Menopause Unscripted Podcast.
I'm Farah Kariamburi, your Belly Blaster Menopause Coach and creator of the Meno-Fit Fat Loss Method, tailored for menopausal women.
As an expert in deep health, I aim to offer professional women simple, effective tips to boost body confidence and regain control during menopause.
Each episode is dedicated to fostering healthier habits, steering clear of temporary fixes like fad diets and pills, for enduring weight loss.
So, grab your cuppa or bring me along on your walk, as we journey towards sustainable results together.

title: The Human Side of Real Estate
author: Mark Twomey
description:
Join host Mark Twomey in "The Human Side of Real Estate" podcast as he delves into the personal and professional stories of guests from the real estate industry. Through these insightful interviews, Mark uncovers the human side of these industry professionals, going beyond the traditional talk of transactions and properties. 

With a focus on personal and professional development, Mark asks questions that reveal the unique journeys, challenges, and triumphs of his guests. Discover the motivations, aspirations, and lessons learned from the individuals who shape the world of real estate. 

Whether you are a seasoned real estate professional, aspiring newcomer, or simply curious about the stories behind the industry, "The Human Side of Real Estate" offers a fresh perspective that inspires, educates, and entertains. Tune in to explore the narratives that make the real estate world not just about buildings, but about the people who bring it to life.

title: CORE LORE

Core Lore explores the expansive minds of the behind-scenes-visionaries moving the most influential facets of culture. A series for fans, followers, and the curious - getting into the most inquisitive minds, meaningful reflections, and lived experiences, with a revealing authenticity that only comes while the body is moving -because the best ideas come when you are moving... So...
"Are we walking or are we running?"
Hosted by @davemarx

description:
Voces con Ethos es el podcast de la Fundación Ethosfera, donde Elena Herrero-Beaumont conversa con algunas de los pensadores más relevantes de nuestro tiempo sobre las grandes cuestiones que están transformando nuestras sociedades.


A través de entrevistas en profundidad con economistas, filósofos, periodistas, científicos y líderes de opinión, el podcast explora temas como la democracia, la economía, la tecnología, la inteligencia artificial, la ética y el futuro de la humanidad.


Conversaciones pausadas, rigurosas y abiertas para comprender mejor los desafíos de nuestro tiempo.

Sometimes, you don’t know where to begin and the only thing left to do is start where you are, right here in the middle.

thedogporch.substack.com

title: Coming Closer
author: James
description: Coming Closer is a gospel-study podcast for anyone who loves to wonder. Written first to my grandchildren — and to anyone willing to listen in, the way we overhear Lehi teaching his sons — each episode chases a question through the scriptures: the history, the languages, the types and shadows, the details easy to read past. It isn't doctrine and I'm no authority; it's the joy of asking, being amazed, and leaving room for the truth as it's revealed. The hope of every episode is simple: to come a little closer to Jesus Christ. I'm James — let's get going.

title: Source History
author: Patience
description:
Source History: Debugging the Past.exe
What if history is just a giant application running in Production?
I am Patience, a VibeCoder inspecting humanity’s greatest events through system logs and failure analysis. We don’t memorize dates; we debug the technical debt left by our ancestors.
From the Silk Road as a Global API to the Roman Empire’s single point of failure, we refactor history using logic and technical metaphors. No academic lectures—just raw system logs of how civilizations scale and crash.
Status: Production. Commit: History is software yet to be debugged.

title: The Alvin Show

title: The Elephant Walk
author: Elephant Advisory
description:
Life is a long walk.


Join us each week for honest conversations with normal people still walking their own journey.


No polished success stories. No pretending to have all the answers. Just real stories, practical lessons, plenty of laughs, and the occasional disagreement.


We talk about money, business, leadership, growth, investing, family, failure, mindset and everything in between.


If you enjoy conversations that make you think, help you grow, and remind you that everyone is still walking their own path, you'll feel right at home.


New episodes every time we take a walking break.


Bought to you by the team at Elephant Advisory, Elephant Teams and Elephant Digital. Hosted by Shehan Wijayasinghe.

title: HVAC Condensed
author: Ferguson
description: Welcome to the podcast built for HVAC contractors who help homeowners stay comfortable season after season. Each episode of HVAC Condensed delivers practical insights, real-world perspectives, and forward-looking ideas designed to help HVAC technicians stay ahead in a rapidly evolving industry. With conversations grounded in experience, we break down what matters most on the job and in the business, cutting through the noise and giving you tools you can put to work. Powered by Ferguson’s deep industry expertise, this podcast is for sharing knowledge, elevating the trade, and supporting the people who do the work every day. Whether you’re in the field, in your truck, or planning the next job, this show is built with you in mind.

title: Business Managers Victoria
author: Tracey Smith
description:
Welcome to the Business Managers Victoria Podcast — the voice of the professionals who keep Victoria's government schools running.

At BMV, we proudly represent the education support staff leading business, administration, finance and people management across our schools. Through insightful conversations, practical ideas and shared experiences, we're committed to strengthening professional standards, supporting continuous learning, and championing the vital work of school business leaders.

Each episode brings together passionate leaders, industry experts and members of our community who are making a difference every day. Together, we'll explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and look outside the square as we continue building stronger schools across Victoria.

This is the Business Managers Victoria Podcast — supporting the people behind great schools.

title: Off Market | Realmark Karratha
author: Jordan James
description:
Get the inside word on Karratha's property market before it hits the headlines. Hosted by Jordan James and the Realmark Karratha team, Off Market brings you straight-talking insights on what's really happening in Karratha real estate sales trends, rental market shifts, investment opportunities and the local knowledge you won't find in a standard market report.


Each episode, Jordan and the team pull back the curtain on the deals, the data, and the decisions shaping Karratha's property landscape, sharing the conversations usually reserved for the office floor.


Whether you're a homeowner, investor, tenant or just Karratha-curious, Off Market gives you an honest, local and unfiltered look at the market from the people in it every day.

Always seek independent advice from a qualified professional before making financial or property decisions.

title: Broken But Still Breathing
author: Jen Weaver and Stasha Parker
description: Living with a chronic illness isn't always about "warrior" metaphors and "beating" the odds; sometimes, it’s just about figuring out how to exist when your body feels like a glitchy operating system. This podcast explores the messy middle ground of disability; the grief of the "former self," the absurdity of medical gaslighting, and the dark humor found in the waiting rheum.

title: Night Airwaves with Bart Graves
author: Bart Graves
description: Night Airwaves with Bart Graves is independent nighttime talk radio from Nashville, exploring science, culture, the unexplained, and the questions nobody else is asking. Hosted by Bart Graves, Night Airwaves is built for a world that feels like it is accelerating faster than people can process. Artificial intelligence, strange objects in our skies, consciousness, dreams, technology, culture, history, the paranormal, and the unanswered questions beneath everyday life all have a place here. This is not outrage radio. It is not corporate radio. It is not another algorithm-fed stream of disposable noise. Night Airwaves is real conversation for curious people who still believe a microphone, an open mind, and a good question can take you somewhere. The show begins in August 2026 with one interview per week, leading into the live Halloween special Grave Airwaves and the end-of-year special Prophetic Airwaves. After getting our feet wet, Night Airwaves expands in 2027 to a live four-night-a-week program, one hour a night. Broadcasting from Nashville, Tennessee, Night Airwaves with Bart Graves follows the questions that do not fit neatly into headlines: science, the unexplained, AI, UAPs, consciousness, strange history, culture, mystery, and the edges of reality. The night is young. And there's a lot to talk about.

description: If you live and breathe Newcastle Knights footy, this is the podcast you've been waiting for. Join lifelong Knights supporters and Foundation Members Greg "Mowie" Mowbray and Paul "Trace" Tracey for All Things Knights. Each episode delivers the sugar and the spice on everything happening in the world of the Newcastle Knights. From match reviews and team selections to player performances, club news, big opinions and plenty of laughs along the way, nothing is off limits.

author: Hanan Iuliano
description:
🎙️ Music Beats Central is your destination for everything music. Hosted by Hanan Iuliano, each episode explores music history, the evolution of music, independent and emerging artists, artist spotlights, industry trends, behind-the-scenes stories, and the moments that shape the soundtrack of our lives. From classic hits to today's biggest releases, you'll discover fascinating insights, celebrate incredible talent, and gain a deeper appreciation for the music we all love. 
🎧 New episodes every Tuesday & Saturday at 9:00 AM AEST.

title: parkrun Audiozine
author: parkrun Global Limited
description:
Now you can listen to parkrun magazine. 

We want to make parkrun magazine accessible to as many people as possible, so in addition to the print version, we’ve created a free audiozine too. It’s perfect for listening to on the way to work, in quiet moments or while you’re out and about walking, jogging or running – basically, any way that suits you. It costs nothing to download. 

Each episode of the audio magazine contains a selection of stories and features adapted from the print edition all about getting started on a more active lifestyle, plus hints and tips about becoming healthier and happier. You’ll also find plenty of stories about the communities around parkrun events. 

We’ve broken down each magazine into a six-episode series, so you can listen in short bursts when you have free time, or you prefer to “binge” and catch up with a whole magazine in one go. Of course, you can rewind and pause the audiozine, too – which could be really helpful if you’re cooking along with some of the recipes!

title: Make Your Own Luck with Karen Brook
author: Karen Brook
description:
Success is never an accident. Every week, Karen Brook shares a short story from her own life, exploring the timeless principles behind creating success. Through lessons on identity, paradigms, leadership, decision-making, self-image, productivity, universal laws and human performance, you'll discover that what most people call luck is often the result of hundreds, if not thousands, of invisible decisions, thoughts and actions that create a person's results.
Whether the story comes from flying an aeroplane, years spent working alongside Bob Proctor and his sone Brian Proctor, building businesses, mentoring leaders or navigating everyday life, each episode opens with a question and finishes with one reflection or action you can apply immediately.
We encourage you not to simply listen.
But listen to understand.
Study each episode with repetition and allow the ideas to become part of the way you think, lead and live.
Because success is never an accident, you make your own luck!

Each month, Robyn and Katherine explore one of the most overlooked, unseen and intangible topics which shape how we feel, interact with each other and move through the world around us. title: Evolution of Mom: EFT Tapping for Moms
author: Shannon Kerr
description:
Are you a mom who feels overwhelmed by all the unreasonable expectations of motherhood?
Are you worried that your big feelings and limiting beliefs are spilling out onto your kids?
Shannon Kerr knows what you're going through, and she's got some tools to help.
Shannon is an Advanced EFT practitioner, sober mom of a blended family and educator in the schools. 
In each episode we'll chat about what's getting in the way of being the mom you want to be, and how to shift your perspective.
EFT tapping is a simple mindbody tool that you can use on the go and for a multitude of purposes. 
Let's tap!

author: Ilana Blum
description:
Not here because I figured it out. I'm still figuring it out, actually.
It's for high-achieving women, and anyone raised to be one, who did everything right and are still asking: is this it?
Every week I get into the brain science behind why we get stuck, coach through real questions from real listeners, and do the honest, messy work of figuring out what we actually want and then going after it.
I'm Ilana, a life coach and founder of 18th Healing. I'm not talking to you from the other side of a transformation. I'm in the middle of one. And I think that matters.
New episodes every week.

title: Crew Connect
author: Ces and Rod
description:
We talk about the systems, culture and realities of life at sea—through honest conversations, funny memories and unfiltered opinions!
After 7 years at sea, we both understand that life at sea, is a very unique "ecosystem" that is mostly talked about through memes, gossip and 15 second reels. And while all of those are necessary, and give crew members a sense of community and understanding, we wanted to try and actually have a longer conversation about the things we loved, the things we struggled with, and the things we hope to one day see improve for all crew onboard.

title: Highway Into Heaven
author: Ginger Arnold and Terry Thompson-Schmitz
description:
Welcome to Highway Into Heaven, a Catholic podcast created by students for students who want to grow deeper in their Faith. Each episode brings real talk on prayer life, inspiring interviews with priests and religious sharing their vocation stories, information on the Saints and how they lived out their Catholic Faith . Whether you're navigating high school, college, or just trying to keep Christ at the center of your life, this show offers encouragement, practical wisdom, and reminds you that you're not alone on this journey. 
Original theme music by Chris Zimmerman and The Saint Songs Band

title: Ho 2 Housewife
author: H2H
description: Hosted by Lauren Hyde and Caroline Wolf, H2H: Ho 2 Housewife is a candid lifestyle podcast where real conversations meet personal growth. From dating and relationships to motherhood, wellness, and self-discovery, every episode delivers honest stories, empowering insights, and the reminder that every woman's journey matters.

title: Scarface, The Valiant
author: LOUDBROWN AUDIO
description: Tragedy, bullying and low self esteem...that was Christy's life until she and a group of her friends decided to turn the tables on the bullies, but neither she nor her friends expected the chain of events that would follow. She just wanted them to leave her alone! Now her world had been turned completely upside down. How could she turn them right-side-up again? Or was that even possible? Hear how one teen overcame the issues of bullying and low self-esteem to find purpose and fulfillment when she encountered a world of fantasy that might be truer than life.

title: Drained Battery Society
author: Peter Conway
description:
Drained Battery Society podcast is for people who remember life before passwords, QR-code menus and being asked to download an app just to park the car. It's a field guide to modern adulthood for anyone who's accumulated a little wisdom, a few aches and pains, and plenty of opinions. 


Hosted by Peter Conway, each episode examines work, aging, technology, modern life and the thousand small indignities nobody warned us about—along with fake sponsors, questionable advice, Universal Truths, and the occasional recommendation that's actually useful.


Drained Battery Society. 

Barely charged. 

Fully opinionated.

title: The Western PA Work Injury Podcast
author: thewesternpaworkinjurypodcast
description: The Western PA Work Injury Podcast is dedicated to providing valuable information and insights for workers navigating the complexities of workplace injuries and compensation claims in Western Pennsylvania. Hosted by experienced professionals, the podcast covers a range of topics from legal rights and employer obligations to practical advice for protecting income and benefits. With a focus on clarity and actionable guidance, the series aims to empower listeners with the knowledge needed to make informed decisions in the wake of a work-related injury.

title: Nutritious Minds Podcast
author: Nutritious Minds Podcast
description: Nutritious Minds Podcast explores brain health, ADHD, neurodivergence, nutrition, and the complexity, fragility, and essence of human life. Hosted by Dr. Rachel V. Gow, each episode brings together leading researchers, expert clinicians, practitioners, and lived-experience voices to translate complex science into real-world conversations for families, adults, educators, and professionals. No sensationalist sound bites. No fluff. Real conversations.

title: The Nachos
author: The Nachos
description:
Hi Fam! 
Welcome to our podcast page. We are Karabo and Sindy, husband and wife who are passionate about seeing our marriage thrive. Journey with us as we navigate it through intentional conversations. Two imperfect yet willing, surrended vessels.

title: The Diaries of Mel: Growing in Real Time
author: Mella
description: This season is about healing, surrender, identity and choosing God daily even when it’s challenging and uncomfortable. It’s raw, reflective and real- time growth.

title: Stronger
author: Sustainable Living
description: Stronger is a podcast for anyone ready to tap into their inner strength, shift their mindset, and live with more purpose. Host Gabby B. explores themes like, self-belief, sustainability, emotional resilience, and personal growth, in an accessible way. Whether you’re just beginning your journey or deepening the one you are on, each episode is here to help you feel empowered, grounded, and ultimately... stronger.

title: Being untethered podcast
author: Miho Otani
description:
here we are creating a space for women who are ready to stop doubting themselves and start becoming the most confident, magnetic version of who they truly are (yes, you!) 
we explore self-love, manifestation, feminine energy, and the science of the subconscious mind

title: Everybody Sells!
author: Beth McClary-Wolford
description:
Business isn’t just about revenue.
It’s about relationships, leadership, visibility, trust, and the conversations that create growth.
Hosted by Beth McClary-Wolford, Everybody Sells features real stories, practical strategies, and straight talk from entrepreneurs, business owners, and leaders who are building something worth keeping.
Whether you’re growing a company, leading a team, serving clients, or building your reputation, you’ll discover why influence, communication, and relationships matter more than ever.
Because whether you realize it or not…
Everybody sells.

title: The Internet Culture Podcast
author: internet-culture
description: A podcast exploring the internet’s biggest stories, viral moments, online drama, social media trends, memes, AI, tech culture, and digital rabbit holes — breaking down what the internet is obsessed with right now and why it matters.

title: AI WORLD TV
author: AI World Journal
description:
AI World TV is a newly launched media channel focused on delivering news, interviews, and analysis about artificial intelligence and its impact on society, business, and technology.
It is part of the broader AI World ecosystem (101 AI World / AI World Media Group LLC) and is designed as a dedicated "AI journalism and insights" platform rather than traditional entertainment TV.

title: Two Therapists, One Couch
author: tammywagnertherapy
description:
Sit down and have a listen to two Saskatchewan Therapists talk about the profession, answer questions that clients frequently have and tackle topics surrounding mental health.

Real talk. Professional Perspectives. Human Connection.

Funny and educational, this podcast is not meant to be in place of therapy.

title: Truck Parking Club: Member Case Studies
author: Truck Parking Club
description:
The Member Case Study Podcast from Truck Parking Club. Each episode is one interview with a real member: property owners who list unused land, lots, and yards for truck parking, and the trucking companies that book those spaces. They walk through how they got started, what they list, what it's earned them, and what running it actually looks like day to day.

If you have space that sits empty or you run trucks and need places to park them, these are the people already doing it, in their own words.

title: Where The Art Lives
author: Tanya Mascarenhas
description: Hosted by artist, art historian and writer Tanya Mascarenhas, Where the Art Lives is a personal podcast where an array of fascinating stories from some of the art world’s most influential gallerists, collectors and curators come to life.

author: Matilda Green
description: Hello! I'm Matilda, and I love stories. On this podcast I'll be reading some of our families' favourite stories. I hope you enjoy!

The very first Episode of That Cobblers Podcast!


The podcast that brings you views, transfers, rumours, match reviews and previews and talks all things Northampton Town FC.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: FPL Pubcast
author: FPL Pubcast
description: The home of the FPL Pubcast and FPL Lock-In podcasts, FPL preview and reaction podcasts hosted by the FPL Pubcast Landlord Gary! Gary is regularly joined by the FPL Pubcast regulars: Trigger, FPL D-Unit, FPL Nightmare, Roberto Hollis, Kanji FPL and FPL Punk as well as by a range of special guests. This is also home of the Meet The FPL Manager podcast.

title: Maverick School Podcast
author: maverickschoolpodcast
description:
School prepared us for exams.
But the world young people are entering today looks completely different.

Degrees don’t guarantee jobs anymore.
Career ladders are disappearing.
AI is reshaping industries faster than most schools can keep up.

And many young people — and their parents — feel it.

That’s where this podcast comes in.

The Maverick School Podcast is about the career education school forgot.

Hosted by an educator with 16+ years of frontline experience helping young people navigate careers, this show explores how the modern world of work actually works — and what young people need to succeed in it.

Each episode features honest conversations with entrepreneurs, leaders, and creatives who are building real careers in today’s economy.

If you’re:
• A young person trying to figure out your direction
• A graduate feeling stuck or behind
• A parent worried about your child’s future
• Or someone trying to understand the new economy

This podcast is for you.

Inside the show we explore:
• How careers really work in the 21st century
• Skills that matter in the new economy
• Networking, personal branding, and opportunity creation
• Money, mindset, and resilience
• How people are building careers outside traditional paths

No fluff.
No outdated advice.
Just real-world insight from people living it.

Because the future belongs to people who learn beyond the classroom.

Welcome to Maverick School.

title: Meeting Point Matters
author: Wayne Jenson
description:
Welcome to the Meeting Point Matters podcast. Brining you informal conversations with the people, charities and organisations creating positive change in our communities. From inspiring stories and practical insights to new projects and community initiatives, we explore the work happening behind the scenes and the impact it has on people's lives.
Join me as I talk with charity professionals and local leaders to share ideas, celebrate success, and discover what it takes to build stronger communities. At the heart of every episode is our commitment to Inspire, Connect and Enable.

title: Elevated Focus
author: Julia Xanthos Liddy
description:
Every woman has a story worth telling and when you're building something meaningful, the way you tell that story matters. 
Welcome to Elevated Focus, hosted by photographer and storyteller Julia Xanthos Liddy. Every Monday, Julia and inspiring guests share honest conversations to help you find clarity, build confidence and create a life and business that's uniquely yours. Because Julia's work has never just been about taking beautiful photographs, it's about helping women be seen. 
Follow and start your next chapter today.

title: Still Human: Real Talk in the Age of AI
author: Nadia Koski
description:
AI is rewriting how we work, how we build,  who benefits, and who gets left behind in the process. We've been told AI is the great equalizer. The data says otherwise.

Still Human: Real Talk in the Age of AI is the podcast that goes inside the rooms where the future is being built and asks the questions nobody's asking on stage and puts the raw conversations on record.

Host Nadia Koski is a marketing and brand strategist as well as podcast network producer, with over a decade in media, content innovation, and advertising technology. Every other week she sits down with the builders, leaders and thinkers navigating this moment: CEOs and startup founders, data scientists and creative directors, NGO leaders, engineers and entrepreneurs doing remarkable things across every time zone.

The conversations are candid, unscripted and go behind-the-scenes on what we're really doing with AI. Nadia gets under every guest's skin, the mental blocks, the habits, the stories they had to unlearn to get where they are today. The question underneath all of it: what does it actually take to stay human while the world rewrites itself around you?

title: The Grumpy Old Man Podcast
author: Kevin Stone
description:
Look, I'm just a bonehead who started a podcast before I was ready to start a podcast. So now, I have a podcast for a whole year without any viable substance to have a podcast about. I am constantly being called, or labeled, or suggested as a grumpy old man where I work.Truth be told it is because I work with a bunch of younger boneheads who haven't matured enough to realize they are boneheads yet, but I have hope in their abbilities to figure that out someday. 

So, I thought, what the heck. Here you go, "The Grumpy Old Man Podcast", hopefully over the course of the next year it will blossom into a world renown podcast and I will become a millionaire, or it will fade away after time and nothing will change. Let's roll the dice.  

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/the-grumpy-old-man-podcast--7213137/support.

title: fumbling together
author: chloe hoang-nguyen
description:
welcome to my cluttered corner - where i publicly search for meaning in life experiences that probably didn't need this much analysis.
what don't i think about without the urge to dissect the psychology behind it? nothing. i take apart adulthood like it's LEGO and somehow still don't have the answers.
i’m self-aware but lost. i'm opinionated but unsure. i'm also ADHD AF. i'm all things in between as i fumble through everything, and nothing at all. is this a mistake? maybe. but it's mine to make. if you're fumbling through life too, welcome in :")

title: Freedom Caucus Podcast
author: Patrick Parsons
description: The Freedom Caucus Podcast, hosted by Patrick Parsons, brings you unfiltered conversations with members of the House Freedom Caucus and other influential voices shaping the future of America. Each episode goes beyond the headlines to explore the biggest battles in Congress, the fight for limited government, constitutional principles, border security, fiscal responsibility, and the issues driving the conservative movement. Whether it's exclusive interviews with lawmakers or engaging discussions with policy experts, candidates, and grassroots leaders, the Freedom Caucus Podcast delivers the insights and behind-the-scenes perspective you won't find anywhere else.

title: The Human Bits
author: Deborah McPhilemy
description: The Human Bits is a podcast about understanding yourself instead of fixing yourself. Through honest, grounded conversations, we explore emotions, trauma, relationships, nervous system healing, self-worth, and the patterns that shape how we think, feel, and behave. It’s a space to make sense of your inner world, reconnect with who you are beneath the noise, and gently unravel the belief that you need to be someone else to feel okay. Together, we focus on creating a life that feels authentic, peaceful, and truly yours.

title: Fractions
author: kavi
description:
What if one label was never enough to define a person?
Movies, storytelling, psychology, fitness, fashion — these aren’t random topics. They’re things I genuinely connect with.
But most people end up being known for just one thing. A role, a label — even though it’s only a part of who they are.
Fractions comes from that idea. This is where I share different parts of myself through the things I care about.
Built as an audio experience you can listen to anytime.
Not one label. Just different fractions of the same person.

title: WOW: Wise Older Women
author: Rasela Torise
description:
“Wisdom that grows louder with time.”


Welcome to WOW: Wise Older Women a podcast dedicated to raising the status of ageing women and dismantling the narratives that silence them.


Here, older women speak with authority, beauty, depth, and fire. Their stories challenge, inspire, and illuminate.


In a world that too often ignores, isolates, or diminishes older women, we choose to listen. To revere and celebrate the brilliance, courage, humour and tenderness they bring along with plenty of high‑vibration wisdom carried in their words.


These conversations aren’t just stories, each one of them is a teaching. A personal map from the past, forging the way ahead, full of magic, medicine and momentum.


This storytelling series presents ageing not as decline, but as ascent. It’s a platform where older women don’t need to hide. This is where they are honoured, uplifted, heard and held; with reverence, respect, and wonder.


Their voices are powerful, their wisdom is vibrant, and their stories are a gift to us all.


Welcome to the podcast. Settle in. Let their voices guide you.

title: Treading Water
author: SWIM Cooperative
description: Treading Water is a podcast by SWIM, S*x Workers in Minnesota. We discuss community, coalition with other s*x workers, education by and for s*x workers, as well as educating those who have never been in the adult industry. We have a local focus on Minnesota, and state and city policies that affect us, however we also talk about worldwide approaches to s*x work, media portrayal of s*x workers and the adult industry, and much more. We highlight SWIM Cooperative's current events and community cultivation while fighting for our rights and safety as well as using this platform as an oral history of our shared experiences.

title: Healing the Soul Devotional Podcast
author: Joyce Meyer
description: A healthy, well-functioning soul is available for every human. No matter what kind of hurt and pain you've been through, you can find hope and healing in God's Word! Through her Healing the Soul Devotional Podcast, Joyce Meyer shares 50 days of devotions that will inspire you to let go of the past and put your trust in God for a new beginning and a brighter future. Whatever the wound, Christ holds the healing.

description:
Lights, Camera, Yaption is like receiving an hour long voice note from your friend who is running late to work and wants to "quickly" tell you their latest take on something you watched when you were 12. Join Samp as he deep dives into TV, Film, TikTok, Pop Culture, that one reality TV show from 2006 he just can't believe hasn't been revived, and more!
Will there be guests? Maybe! Will there be hot nuanced takes about media? Maybe! Will there be laughter? God he hopes so.

title: Chase Your Extraordinary Podcast
author: Chase Your Extraordinary
description: The Chase Your Extraordinary Podcast is for ordinary people curious about what they might be capable of. Through honest conversations, lived adventures and the messy middle, we explore movement, mindset, setbacks and the small choices that build confidence. No empty motivational slogans—just real stories, practical lessons and an invitation to ask: “I wonder if I can…?” You don’t need to run across a country. Walking counts. Five minutes counts. Starting again counts. Wherever you’re starting, you’re welcome here.

title: Dead Format
author: The staff of the Dead Storage VHS Rental Shop in Gateshead
description:
Synopsis
A haunted VHS rental shop that never closed, tucked away in your neighbourhood, is the only place left to escape to for a duvet day of favourite films—where the internet is down, and the films might just have a life of their own.
Each episode, your hosts (the shop’s employees) chat about films in a freewheeling, nostalgic, and slightly surreal way. Sometimes, a strange VHS turns up. Sometimes, the shop’s mysterious owner leaves cryptic instructions. And sometimes, a film might not end the way you remember it…

Leadership can be inspiring, but it can also be challenging, lonely, and demanding. The Imagine Leadership Podcast is a space for honest conversations that help shape healthy leaders.

Tune in as we sit down with highly esteemed, world-renowned astrologers to explore the powerful cosmic forces shaping our collective experience. Instead of getting lost in individual chart details, this show lifts its gaze to the bigger picture. Our expert guests analyze major world events, global shifts, and historical cycles through a mundane and archetypal lens. Whether you are a seasoned practitioner or a curious observer of global trends, this podcast bridges ancient wisdom with modern global headlines. 
Subscribe now to understand the celestial currents driving today’s changing world!

title: This Still Hits
author: kimwindyka
description: On This Still Hits, join Jean, Danielle, and Kim as they discuss (almost) all the pop culture that they experienced as kids, pre-teens, teens, and even 20-somethings — and whether or not it still holds up today. We’ll jump from movies to music, TV to MySpace. If you’re down to listen to elder millennials as we wax nostalgic, this is for you!

title: How to Start a Business for Free
author: Derron Amrein
description:
How to Start a Business for Free is a build-in-public podcast documenting the real journey of creating businesses from the ground up using AI, free tools, and relentless problem solving.
Each episode follows entrepreneur Derron Amrein as he turns ideas into real companies—sharing the wins, mistakes, pivots, and lessons learned along the way. Instead of talking about entrepreneurship in theory, this podcast shows what it actually looks like to validate ideas, build MVPs, attract customers, develop products, pitch businesses, leverage artificial intelligence, and launch startups with little capital.
Whether you’re interested in entrepreneurship, startups, SaaS, AI, product development, small business, no-code tools, marketing, sales, customer validation, or building a business while working a full-time job, you’ll get practical insights you can apply immediately.
Current episodes follow the development of Stride Guide, an AI-powered retail platform designed to help independent retailers increase customer traffic, improve retention, train employees, and create more predictable recurring revenue.
If you’re looking for honest founder stories instead of overnight success, subscribe and build alongside us.
New episodes every week.

title: The Real Estate Roundtable with Mike Leblanc
author: Mike Leblanc
description: Join host Mike Leblanc as he welcomes seasoned real estate investors, managers, agents, and industry experts to dive deep into the world of real estate. From starting your first investment to mastering advanced strategies, this podcast is your guide to success. Get an exclusive glimpse into the life of Mike Leblanc as he navigates between the dynamic real estate industry, maintaining a healthy household, and most importantly, enjoying life along the way.

Building What Lasts is a podcast about creating a meaningful life rooted in faith, family, purpose, and intentional work.

Hosted by Michelle Kay, a wife, mom of four, small business owner, and creative entrepreneur, each episode explores what it means to build things that endure. From entrepreneurship and marketing to motherhood, personal growth, productivity, wellness, and faith, Michelle shares honest stories, practical strategies, and thoughtful conversations to help you stay focused on what matters most.

Whether you're growing a business, raising a family, pursuing creative work, or seeking a more intentional life, you'll find encouragement and wisdom for building a life, vocation, and legacy that lasts.

title: SoulSpeak Podcast
author: Donna Karaba
description:
SoulSpeak: Where Purpose Meets Presence

SoulSpeak is a podcast for people seeking healing, alignment, and authentic leadership in both life and career.

Hosted by Donna Karaba, a former Fortune 500 executive who chose a more deeply aligned path rooted in purpose and authenticity, SoulSpeak explores what happens when we stop following external paradigms and start trusting the inner voice guiding us toward something more.

This show is for:

• Individuals navigating chronic pain or searching for alternative approaches to healing and holistic wellness
 • Professionals feeling stuck, burned out, or misaligned in their careers
 • Women balancing ambition, leadership, and personal fulfillment
 • Aspiring entrepreneurs and career pivoters ready to follow their passion
 • Leaders seeking authentic, purpose-driven leadership
 • Anyone who feels the quiet unrest of living out of alignment

Through conversations with clinicians, founders, innovators, thought leaders, and courageous pivoters, SoulSpeak explores:

• Integrative and holistic perspectives on health and well-being
 • Healing beyond conventional systems
 • Career transitions and reinvention
 • Leadership development rooted in integrity
 • Personal growth and self-trust
 • Building a life aligned with passion and purpose

If you’ve ever felt like your soul was shrinking inside a life that looked successful on paper… this podcast is for you.

Because healing isn’t just physical.
 And success isn’t just external.

Alignment changes everything.

title: SIGNAL: Grounded in Truth
author: Michael Vincent
description:
Everyone in this industry has a podcast now. Give it a year, the freight brokers will too.

So yes, we know the irony. We're launching a show into an industry with more voices than listeners, more hot takes than actual takes, more people explaining freight on camera than people who've dispatched a truck. Noise isn't what we're short on. It's what we're drowning in.

Here's the difference. SIGNAL: Grounded in Truth is long-format, on purpose. Truth doesn't fit in ninety seconds. A ninety-second clip is somebody's opinion wearing a blazer. A real conversation, given room to breathe, stops performing and starts being honest — worth thirty minutes of your day, and none of your scrolling.

In 1 Kings 19:11-12, Elijah stood on the mountain expecting God in the wind, the earthquake, the fire — and found Him instead in the still small voice that came after. Most of what passes for insight here is wind, earthquake, and fire. We built this show for the quiet after. That's where the signal lives.

Industry leaders. Operators. People who've lived with their own decisions. No fluff, no scripts, no one performing for an algorithm.

Available on all major podcast platforms. Follow 146 Media — 146-Media on LinkedIn, @146Media1 on X, 146media on Instagram, @146Media-Spartan on YouTube.

The industry doesn't need another voice. It needs somewhere quiet enough to hear the ones already worth hearing.

Peace and Love.

Tyrella Off the Record brings you timely updates on the cases you care about most, from courtroom testimony and new filings to breaking developments and the context behind the headlines.
I'm Tyrella, a true crime host since 2017, formerly of Killer Queens which is now This Feels Criminal. Here, I follow cases as they unfold and break down what happened, why it matters, and what you need to know next—without requiring you to spend all day watching court or refreshing social media.
Some episodes are quick updates. Others go deeper when a story needs more context. During major trials, you'll find regular coverage of testimony, witnesses, rulings, and the moments that could shape the case.

title: Magnetic Barbering Podcast
author: Roger Bickley
description:
Magnetic Barbering Podcast The Magnetic Barbering Podcast documents Rog tha Barber’s journey to build 250 Magnetic Barbering locations across America.

This is bigger than opening barbershops. It’s about building a barbering system that creates:
  • Affordable, quality haircuts for clients
  • Strong income and real opportunity for barbers
  • Safe, clean spaces for children and families
  • Comfortable environments where mothers feel respected
  • Community-centered shops where people can connect
  • A business model built to last for generations
You’ll hear the real journey—the plans, decisions, mistakes, wins, setbacks, numbers, marketing, hiring, leadership, expansion, and everything it takes to turn one vision into a national barbering brand. No fake success story after everything is already finished.

You’re watching it get built in real time. The mission is simple: Help barbers earn more.

Help clients get great cuts at fair prices.

Build safe shops that communities trust.

Create a system that survives for generations. This is not just a barber podcast.

 This is the story of building the future of barbering. Welcome to Magnetic Barbering.

title: When People Lead
author: Jeffrey Rola
description:
When People Lead (taken from the Gandhi quote, "When the people lead, the leaders follow.") is a simple premise in three parts. First we celebrate people who strive to make the world a little bit better each day. We host conversations with leaders in science, culture, justice and environment. Most are not well known, working on obscure projects in remote communities. But some can be found right in your neighborhood. 
Next, we use the podcast medium itself. From our micro-studio on the south coast of Oregon we can speak to the world -- and the world can speak to us. We will use our mics and cameras to connect what anthropologist Margaret Meade called, "those small groups of committed citizens," that change the world. 
Third, we end each episode with the call to action, "Find the leader within." We hope to build a network of leaders sharing ideas, perspectives and insights, all in service to the common good. right now this seems like a tall order. We believe that there is no problem too great to overcome When People Lead.
